$comment: Developer sandboxes. Nothing else belongs here.
This repo covers the development phase only: 'dv sync' registers steps into a sandbox you
are signed into, and 'dv pack' builds a .zip for another module to import. There are no test
or production entries because nothing here imports into those - and so no credential is ever
wanted in this file. Sign-in is interactive and the token is cached outside the repo.
To point 'dev' at your own sandbox without touching this shared file, create
config/environments.local.json (git-ignored); it is merged over this one.

dev.description: Shared developer sandbox. Override it locally with your own.
